transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss Batch 47 — the 600 adhesive-bonded components currently on hold due to cure readings falling below our normal release specification. Before I make a disposition decision, I need to gather the full picture. Can quality engineering share the latest test results, and can maintenance let me know about any equipment constraints we should be aware of? I want to make sure we have everything on the table before we move forward with release, scrap, or controlled rework.
